title: Taverns
description: Taverns are places where you find beds and a Trader selling maps to some of the dungeons or ruins of this datapack. you need to level the villager, while they are inside the tavern, up to aprentice, to make them a tavern cartographer.

title: Firewatch towers
description: They are atmospheric builds to make the world feel more lived in. you can use them as a small base or just to find a nights rest

title: Mangrove Swamp Hut
description: the witches moved into the mangrove swamp with 3 different hut styles

title: Illager Hideout
description: A rare underground Dungeon that is filled with Illagers. a challenge for late game player who seek a challenge

description: 'tis but a terraria reference

title: Jungle Ruins
description: You aren't a fan of the small Jungle temple? maybe search for Jungle ruins then.  Bogged spawn here and you can find the Photosynthesis Enchantment here

title: Witch Villa
description: Spawning in swamp biomes and Mangrove Swamps those structure act as witches woodland mansion with their own experiments and own backyard

title: Ruined Towns
description: Ruined Towns are ruins from the past with rubble everywhere with suspicious gravel holding mostly just junk but maybe some sherds and other tressures

title: Swamp Villages
description: Find villages in swamp with... witches? seems like getting that mending librarian isn't going to be that easy.

title: Jungle Villages
description: Spawning in Jungles are now jungle villages

title: Bunker
description: A somewhat rare structure that resembles surface exposed strongholds, they have a bigger room variety and dont have an end portal chamber

title: Piglin Donjon
description: The Donjon is a Megastructure spawning rarely in crimson forest biomes containing several room types of the various bastion remnants and container crates filled with gold. also look out for hidden vault rooms. Ontop is a Coloseum for Vault keys

title: End Ships
description: Lone Endships spawning within the end containing a vault needing an End Ship Vault Key. Those vaults always hold Elytra. Maybe even enchanted with Wax Wings

title: End Lighthouse
description: Structures spawning in the End acting as Ends version of Taverns. you can find maps here for End Castles and obtain End Ship Keys

title: End Castle
description: Ends version of a Stronghold and Endcity Hybrid. you can find Gravity, Wax Wings, End Ship Keys, End Crystals and other things here. can be found either with an End Castle Map or Eyes of Ender

title: Shrines
description: Shrines leading down to 1-5 themed combat arenas that all follow 1 theme per shrine, amound of copper bulbs indicate how many rooms there are. you can find Shrine Keys, Ominous Shrine keys and Traveler here. Ominous vaults are only in lv 5 shrines

title: Toxic Lair
description: Swamp Structure found in swamp biomes. Surface area has ruins with suspicious gravel but the inside leads to an underground structure with a miniboss and several trial spawner/vaults and ominous vaults. you can find Antidote, Piercing/Multishot bows here

title: Triden Trail Monument
description: Grant Prismarine structure not spawning guardians naturally but from trial spawner here, you can obtain tridents, heart of the sea and other goodies here

title: Lone Citadel
description: Probably Dungeons and Taverns biggest structure yet. Recreating the Lone Fortress from Minecraft Dungeons and bringing it to vanilla. Breezes and Strays are at home here. you can obtain the Might Enchantment and Aerials Bane here

title: Creeping Crypt
description: Creeping Crypts are an structure found in taiga biomes, filled with creeper, gunpowder, suspicious gravel and if you are lucky, even an creeper spawner alongside the other trial spawner spawning creepr and undead

title: Nether Keep
description: This Mega Structure is an giant tower spawning inside the nether, containing 3 blaze spawner rooms with their own treasure chests. bridges hold trialspawner and arenas to obtain keys for the vault inside. you can obtain a chart for the Sealing Halls here.

title: Remnants
description: Remnants are rare enviromental ruins, not different from wild ruins but MUCH MUCH rarer. one of them is a classic village that is abandoned

title: Illager Camp
description: A small somewhat rare camp with a few decorations spreaded around the main campfire, has a chest with a chart for a pillager outpost

title: Piglin Camp
description: Piglin Camps are somewhat common structures holding gold ore and charts to Hamlets

title: Hamlets
description: Hamlets are a Piglin structure with a Piglin village and apartment complex inside its underground part. They contain magma slime trial spawner and vaults that hold charts for Piglin Outstations

title: Piglin Outstation
description: Piglin Outstation are a rare Piglin Structure that are very inspired by the "Horde of the Bastion" Outpost in Minecraft legends as well as the vault rooms in Minecraft Dungeons Ancients Raids. They contain Vaults with charts for the Piglin Donjon.

title: Nether Skeleton Towers
description: Those Encampments spawn with skeletons and wither skeletons and hold chest to other biome types of the Nether Skeleton Tower and 1 chest with a chart for a Nether Port. Mobs do not respawn.

title: Nether Ports
description: Nether Ports are a Nether Skeleton structure that always generates at lava level with a central structure and ports with towers spawning around it, it contains trial spawner and vaults with the Swift Soar enchantments and 1 Chart for the Nether Keep

title: Sealing Halls
description: Acting as the Nether Skeletons Equaliment to the Piglin Donjon, this structure is the rarest DnT Nether structure and you can find all DnT Nether Enchantments here as well as a trial spawner with Ominous Consequences.

title: Stray Fort
description: Rare structure that generates in cold biomes and spawns more strays than usual during the night. You can find a chart for the Lone Citadel here.

title: Stray Outlook
description: rare structure that spawns in cold biomes with either spruce or stone walls. you can obtain a Stray Fort Chart here

title: Catacombs
description: Underground Deepslate structure that spawns, in cold biomes, under y level 0. No notable loot besides skulls if you like skulls.

title: Cave Chambers
description: Cave Chambers are the wild ruins of the underground. they spawn with a working fake cave system around them to integrate themself naturally in the underground worldgen. sometimes they have Vaults that require Cave Chamber Keys. some have trial spawners.

title: Trial Dungeon
description: Underground structure with 1 guranteed Spawner and 1-8 Trial spawner, adabt to cave gen with the same system as cave chambers and also spawn with vaults that require Cave Chamber Keys. the spawner there do give those out sometimes.

title: Illager Manor
